Review: CAPM 
 Since each investor holds the tangency portfolio as	 Since each investor holds the tangency portfolio as 
part of his/her overall portfolio, the market portfolio 
must coincide with the tangency portfolio. 
 Idea of CAPM: the contribution of a single risky asset 
to the risk of the market portfolio must be 
proportional to its risk premiumproportional to its risk premium. 
 In other words, investors are compensated for 
expposure to syystematic risk. 
 Idiosyncratic risk is not compensated because they 
can be diversified away.

Consider a portfolio with expected return of 16% 
and assume that it is on the efficient frontier. 
a. What is the beta of this portfolio? 
b. What is the standard deviation of its return? 
c. What is its correlation with the market return?
